verdict.rationale: Call analytics is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, but the evidence pack never documents a built-in dashboard showing call success rates, durations, outcomes or sentiment. The A/B testing note in deepgram-docs-17 mentions measuring conversion, CSAT or containment rate, but it does not say Deepgram provides dashboards for those metrics. It reads as a use case for reusable configurations rather than a first-party analytics feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
